description: NaUBO₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcm space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.78 Å. U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.42 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.36 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent U and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one U atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one U atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one U, and one B atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂UB tetrahedra.
